nonhead_order_exists.meaning: a non-head order exists in a price level's doubly linked list

append_requires_both_links.meaning: a new order is appended to a price level requiring both forward and back links to be updated

open_interest_matches_reachable.meaning: open-interest counters reflect reachable orders only (counters correspond to orders addressable via the headOrder/tailOrder chain)

assumptions: The corruption persists because every operation is wrapped in a successful transaction.
No authorization requirement is stated for append/removal; the claim is not an access-control property.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition of open-interest counters or reachable-order count, so the correspondence is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than an arithmetic equality.

limitations: Only the open-interest misstatement impact is formalized; head-move, invisibility, and sentinel impacts are handled in separate passes.
The correspondence is expressed qualitatively because the report omits counter arithmetic and concrete values.
